properties.name: synapsys.enabled
properties.description: Whether this worker connects to Synapsys Core. Set to false to keep the starter on the classpath without heartbeats or console capture, as in integration tests.

properties.name: synapsys.core-url
properties.description: Base URL of the Synapsys Core service used by this worker.

properties.name: synapsys.core-token
properties.description: Bearer token used to authenticate requests from this worker to Synapsys Core. Store it in a secret rather than committing it to source control.

properties.name: synapsys.worker-name
properties.description: Logical name of the worker application. Defaults to spring.application.name when omitted; required when spring.application.name is not set.

properties.name: synapsys.host
properties.description: Host reported to Synapsys Core. Defaults to the machine hostname; set explicitly when the resolved name is meaningless, as with a container id.

properties.name: synapsys.heartbeat-interval
properties.description: Positive whole-second interval between worker heartbeats sent to Synapsys Core.

properties.name: synapsys.fail-fast
properties.description: Whether application startup should fail when Synapsys Core is unreachable.

properties.name: synapsys.connect-timeout
properties.description: Maximum time allowed to establish an HTTP connection to Synapsys Core.

properties.name: synapsys.request-timeout
properties.description: Maximum time allowed for a Synapsys Core HTTP request to complete.
